# Pluto Theory

> Marketing in a click. Pluto Theory builds AI marketing automations and offers them on subscription: SEO, lead generation, CRM and follow-up, WhatsApp, LinkedIn and Instagram content, performance marketing, PR and websites. About 70% of the business is these automations; the other 30% is a studio team for brand, shoots, PR outreach and bespoke builds.

- Based in: Hyderabad, Telangana, India; works with businesses in India and worldwide
- Contact: info@plutotheory.com or https://www.plutotheory.com/contact
- Tagline: Marketing in a click.
- Availability: every automation is in early access; pricing is shared on a demo call. Advertising spend is never part of the subscription.

## Automations

- [SEO automation](https://www.plutotheory.com/automations/seo): Keep site checks, improvement work and SEO reporting moving.
- [Lead generation](https://www.plutotheory.com/automations/lead-generation): Capture and organise supported enquiries, then connect them to a clear next step.
- [CRM & follow-up](https://www.plutotheory.com/automations/crm): Keep records, owners and follow-ups connected.
- [WhatsApp automation](https://www.plutotheory.com/automations/whatsapp): Answer enquiries, send reminders and follow up on WhatsApp, with a person ready to step in.
- [LinkedIn content](https://www.plutotheory.com/automations/linkedin): Turn your expertise into a repeatable content process.
- [Instagram content](https://www.plutotheory.com/automations/instagram): Bring assets, captions, reviews and scheduling together.
- [Performance marketing](https://www.plutotheory.com/automations/performance-marketing): Bring campaign information, checks and next actions together.
- [PR workflow](https://www.plutotheory.com/automations/pr): Find opportunities, prepare angles and track next steps.
- [Websites & landing pages](https://www.plutotheory.com/automations/websites): Create and maintain useful pages, then connect their enquiries to the next step.
- [All automations](https://www.plutotheory.com/automations)

## How it works and pricing

- [How it works](https://www.plutotheory.com/how-it-works): choose an automation, connect the tools it needs, set rules and approvals, then review the work.
- [Pricing](https://www.plutotheory.com/pricing): one automation, connected bundles (for example lead generation with CRM follow-up) or studio support. Every plan states its included work, limits, setup, support and extra charges.
- [Demos](https://www.plutotheory.com/demos): live walkthroughs, labelled as prototype, test, pilot or production.

## Studio

- [Studio](https://www.plutotheory.com/studio): brand and messaging, product and brand photography, AI photoshoots, PR strategy and outreach, bespoke websites.

## Guides

- [LinkedIn automation rules: what LinkedIn allows, and what gets accounts restricted](https://www.plutotheory.com/blog/linkedin-automation-rules): What LinkedIn's help pages say about bots, scrapers and browser extensions, why accounts get restricted, and which parts of a LinkedIn content process you can safely automate.
- [A simple CRM setup for a small sales team: stages, owners and follow-ups](https://www.plutotheory.com/blog/crm-for-small-business-india): How to set up a simple CRM for a small sales team in India: pipeline stages, owners, follow-up rhythm, published tool prices as of November 2026 and where AI helps.
- [Marketing automation for small businesses in India: where to start without wasting money](https://www.plutotheory.com/blog/marketing-automation-small-business-india): What to automate first as a small business in India, what you need before you start, indicative CRM, email and WhatsApp costs as of November 2026, the rules that apply, and a four-week plan.
- [SEO automation: what you can safely automate, and what still needs a person](https://www.plutotheory.com/blog/seo-automation-what-to-automate): Which SEO tasks to automate (crawls, indexing and schema checks, tracking, briefs, reports), which still need a person, what Google says about automation and AI content, and a simple weekly routine.
- [How to automate lead follow-up with AI (website, ads and WhatsApp)](https://www.plutotheory.com/blog/automate-lead-follow-up-with-ai): How to capture, acknowledge, route and follow up website, ad and WhatsApp leads with AI, the rules to respect in India, where a person should stay, and a four-week setup plan.
- [15 business tasks you can automate with AI this month](https://www.plutotheory.com/blog/business-tasks-to-automate-with-ai): Fifteen business tasks to automate with AI, sorted by sales, support, finance, marketing, HR and operations, with how each works, where a person should stay in the loop and a four-week plan to start.
- [What an AI automation agency does, what it costs in India, and how to pick one](https://www.plutotheory.com/blog/ai-automation-agency-india): What AI automation agencies build, published build and running costs in India in 2026, the questions to ask before hiring one, red flags, and when to do it yourself.
- [How to choose a branding agency in Hyderabad](https://www.plutotheory.com/blog/branding-agency-hyderabad): What branding costs in Hyderabad in 2026, the questions to ask an agency before you sign, red flags, who owns the logo under Indian copyright law, and how to compare quotes.
- [How much does product photography cost in Hyderabad?](https://www.plutotheory.com/blog/product-photography-cost-hyderabad): What product photography costs in Hyderabad in 2026: per-image and day rates, what changes the price, hidden costs, and how to get an accurate quote.
- [AI photoshoot vs real photoshoot: which one does your brand need?](https://www.plutotheory.com/blog/ai-photoshoot-vs-real-photoshoot): An honest comparison of AI photoshoots and real product photoshoots: cost, speed, product accuracy, models, marketplace rules, and when a mix of both works best.
- [Brand identity for startups in India: what you actually need](https://www.plutotheory.com/blog/brand-identity-checklist-startups-india): What a startup brand identity should include, what can wait, how to check a name before you fall in love with it, and the mistakes that make brands look generic.
